notes.title: Update 1.1.1!
notes.content:
[b]What's new in 1.1.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix for front door incorrectly opening on a new loop..
[*] Removed extra magpie.
[*] Fix for exit (X icon) being enabled on start.
[/list]
[b]What's new in 1.1.0:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix for interacting with the Club Distraction poster through the bathroom wall.
[*] Fix for Loop3 puzzle triggering too early.
[*] Added support for inverted mouse controls.
[*] Documentary videos and credit sequences are now correctly affected by audio controls.
[*] Fix for poster credits not displaying correctly.
[*] Fix for letter clipping on the fridge.
[*] Fix for beanbag achievement not unlocking.
[*] Level select now displays how many beanbag chats have been viewed.
[*] Fix for trapdoor not opening correctly.
[/list]
